messages:
Maria: Quick sync — finalizing launch posts + webinar plan + free-credit experiment for next week. Can we lock routing and benchmarks today?
Jordan: Yep — I have a draft benchmark narrative (calls out latency/cost per token vs competitor) — posted in Drive: https://drive.google.com/benchmark-v2
Sam: Link works. For inbound routing: propose tag-based funnel: trial_signup -> credits_flow; demo_request -> sales_hand_off; webinar_reg -> nurture_seq
Maria: Can you paste the routing snippet here? I'll add to the runbook.
Sam: ```
routes:
  trial_signup: /funnels/credit-onboard
  demo_request: /funnels/sales-handoff
  webinar_reg: /funnels/webinar-nurture
```
Lee: For credit size A/B: 2000 tokens vs 6000 tokens. My read: bigger credit lifts activation but costly. Suggest start with 2k / 6k test with 50/50 split.
Jordan: We should also test two onboarding prompt templates: 'starter prompts' vs 'templates + use-case wizard'. I'll push both into the template library and tag cohorts.
Maria: Metric guardrails: primary = % activated (first 3 meaningful requests) within 7 days; secondary = token spend per activated user; stop if cost per activation > $30.
CreditsBot: Reminder: credits package 'launch-2k' ready for issuance; set expiry 30d. Use code: LAUNCH2026
Sam: Operational checklist: 1) webhook for lead tags -> routes 2) credit issuance rule 3) email drip 0/24/72h 4) analytics events: credit_claimed, first_prompt_used, activated
Maria: @Jordan @Lee assign owners? I'll own the webinar landing copy. Jordan — you own benchmark narrative and templates. Sam — implement routing + analytics. Lee — monitor A/B and pause if CPI>30.
Jordan: :thumbsup: will update the doc and drop a Loom by EOD.
Lee: I'll wire up the dashboards and add an alert for CPI>30 and activation delta >10%.
Maria: Quick ask — tweet thread and launch post schedule? Jordan can you draft 3 short LinkedIn posts and one 8-tweet thread. Planning to post day after webinar.
Jordan: On it. Drafts by tomorrow morning. Also prepping a short benchmark highlight graphic — need model perf numbers from engineering.
Sam: Tagging eng-ml channel for perf numbers: @eng-ml can someone export latency/cost table by model for public benchmark?
CreditsBot: Deploy note: credits issuance job scheduled at 2026-04-01T09:00Z if configs merged.
Maria: Thanks everyone, wrapping. Recording of this thread for runbook. LMK if blockers.
